column5: STRONGEST FIGMA PARITY OF THE EIGHT GAMES. All 10 component frames verified `match`: Desktop 9178-4169, Desktop Start 9178-8146, Desktop Split 9178-6080, Mid Game button actions 9178-4037, Side Bet Tab 9178-8446, Side Bet Mobile 9178-10465, Mobile 9178-9840, Pointer 9178-8439 and 9178-10677 / 9178-12508. The 3 page frames (desktop 9003-117337, tablet 9003-119356, mobile 9003-119858) pass a numeric DOM audit with 0 missing sections at 1440/768/375. ★ THE 3:2-vs-EVEN-MONEY CONFLICT IS RESOLVED, AND THE FELT WON. The felt ribbon and the rules panel both promise "Blackjack pays 3 to 2"; the POINTS rail used to compute `ret = h.bet * 2.5` and then FLOOR it, so a natural on a 1-point stake returned floor(2.5) = 2 - even money. The felt was authoritative (3:2 is the advertised, industry-standard rule and the rail's own header comment claims it at supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts:2336), so the RAIL was underpaying, and the fix is `ret = Math.round(ret)` at supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts:2722 - the fraction is only ever exactly 0.5, so half-up never pays less than the advertised rule and every even stake is untouched. Landed in commit 7aa07b6d8 (2026-08-04) and VERIFIED LIVE: deployed points-game v99 (deployed 2026-08-05T01:36Z, after the 22:47Z commit) contains `Math.round(ret)` and zero occurrences of `Math.floor(ret)`. Side bets at index.ts:2846-2847 still floor, which is correct and must not be "unified": every Perfect Pairs / 21+3 multiplier is a whole number (25/12/6, 100/40/30/10/5), so the floor is a no-op there rather than a truncated half-point. ★ THE RULES PANEL WAS THE REMAINING LIAR, NOT THE FELT (fixed this pass, BlackjackGame.tsx). It printed FOUR numbers the rail contradicts: (a) "8 Deck Shoe" read `config?.numberOfDecks`, a field that does not exist on `BlackjackConfig`, so the `|| 8` fallback ALWAYS won while BOTH rails deal SIX decks (points-game `BJ_DECK_COUNT = 6`; game-settlement / blackjackGameService `createDeck(numDecks = 6)`) - a wrong deck count moves basic-strategy edge; (b) "Min Bet: {configMinBet} SKAI / Max Bet: {configMaxBet} SKAI" printed SKAI-scale bounds with a hardcoded SKAI suffix to a POINTS player whose real bounds are 1..1000 POINTS (`activeMinBet` / `activeMaxBet`); (c) "Insurance pays 2:1" sold a side bet POINTS never offers (`insuranceAvailable: false`, index.ts:3096); (d) "Blackjack pays 1.5:1 (3:2)" printed one ratio twice in two notations. All four now render the rail's real value. PlayTable.tsx's Blackjack card also claimed "surrender supported" and "~99.5% RTP" against the engine's own ~99.4% (0.63% edge, 6-deck H17) - both corrected. ★ 9003-118852 IS A NOT-READY RIVAL DUPLICATE - DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT. It and 9003-119356 carry a byte-identical title at the SAME 768 viewport, so no route, state or breakpoint can distinguish them; only one can render. Figma metadata settles which is the draft: 118852 nests a layer literally NAMED `Desktop` at width 708 (9003:118857) inside a 468-wide parent (9003:118856), overflowing it by 120px per side - the desktop board pasted at tablet width and never adapted - while 119356's board is the resized square `Tablet 6` 422x461 that matches the mobile frame 9003-119858. 118852's breadcrumb also reads `Blackjack` where 119356 and mobile read `BlackJack`. 119356 is the later node-id, is already built (BlackjackPageSections.tsx) and a prior sweep verified it `match`, so building 118852 would REGRESS a verified layout to reproduce an unadapted paste. Nothing below the board differs between the two. Both frames additionally draw content that must not be built: the retired `Practice mode off` toggle (9003:119199/119200 - practice mode was removed in a28c5b3, standing product rule), a game-details thumbnail whose layer is named `Cards ALT - Chicken` (9003:119080, another game's art), and five fabricated Community-wins rows (@CryptoQueen88 / Salem Kare / Ohamballa Joyson / @DeFiMaster2024, all with the identical $8,481.10 bet). The build correctly renders `useRecentBets` with honest loading/empty states instead. ★ SURRENDER IS NOT A FIGMA GAP - CONFIRMED AGAINST THE FRAME. 9178-4037 draws exactly four CTA/button children (9003:118981 Hit, 9003:118992 Stand, 9003:118999 Split, 9003:119008 Double); the tablet frame's action row repeats the same four. So the dead surrender path is a RULES-CONFIG DEFECT: `canSurrenderAction` (BlackjackGame.tsx) and `handleSurrender` are computed/defined and referenced by NO JSX, the keyboard shortcut was already removed, and the POINTS engine's VALID_ACTIONS set has no "surrender" so the call would 400. getBlackjackConfig() already pinned `surrenderAllowed: false` on its success path, but DEFAULT_CONFIG and the component's FALLBACK_BLACKJACK_CONFIG still said `true`, so one failed config fetch re-advertised it - both now pinned false, alongside `canResplitAces: false` (POINTS marks both ace-split hands standing; the on-chain `canSplit` never reads the flag at all). No surrender control was built. Insurance is the same shape (on-chain only, in no frame). ✅ PRACTICE MODE ALREADY REMOVED (a28c5b3) and the orphan tests/practiceBlackjack.test.ts is GONE - that catalog line was stale. Remaining known drift, unfixed and reported: the ADMIN rules config is decorative - neither backend reads blackjack_dealer_hits_soft17 or its siblings, and BlackjackConfigCard.tsx:158 / AdminJackpotConfig.tsx:275 still expose a blackjack payout ratio no rail consults, so an operator can still change what an admin is SHOWN without changing what is DEALT. ★ A REAL 2px PARITY DEFECT ON THE TABLET + MOBILE FRAMES, FIXED THIS PASS (BlackjackBetPanel.tsx). src/index.css forces `min-height: 44px` on every `button` at `max-width: 768px`, and min-height BEATS a `height` declaration - so the panel's three `h-[42px]` control groups (the 1/2 / 2X / Max chips, the currency segments, and the Manual | Side Bet tabs, whose halves are 34px inside a 42px track) all rendered 44px tall at 768 and below, against Figma's 42. Worst case was the tab row: a 44px child forced through a 42px parent. Fixed with the sanctioned per-control opt-out `:not(.no-min-size)` on those buttons; index.css itself is NOT touched. This affects 9178-9840, 9178-10465 and both 768 page frames - it is invisible at 1440, which is why a desktop-only screenshot sweep passed them. ★★★ 2026-08-05 - THE ADMIN RULES CONFIG WAS DECORATIVE AND IS NOW VISIBLY READ-ONLY. Not a frame gap; a money-surface gap, and the reason it matters is that an operator could change what an ADMIN IS SHOWN without changing what is DEALT. Traced every blackjack_* key from its write site to its read site: 9 of 12 are read by nothing that affects an outcome. The rules are hard-coded independently in all THREE settlement paths - points-game/index.ts:2683 hits soft 17 unconditionally (under a comment calling it "the fixed rule"), game-settlement/index.ts:8881 reads BJ_CONFIG.dealerHitsSoft17 which is a module-level `const true` at :7577 never assigned from the DB, and 20260326_blackjack_hmac_shuffle.sql:269-270 does the same in SQL. Payouts likewise: points-game:2706 `ret = h.bet * 2.5`, game-settlement:8924 off the literal `blackjackPays: 1.5` at :7576, SQL :296 `* 2.5`. Surrender is not even a legal action on POINTS (points-game:2952 VALID_ACTIONS omits it, :2955 400s anything else). DEAD KEYS, no read site outside the admin form: blackjack_dealer_hits_soft17, blackjack_allow_surrender, blackjack_payout_ratio, blackjack_insurance_payout, blackjack_deck_count, blackjack_suited_bj_multiplier, blackjack_suited_777_multiplier. DISPLAY-ONLY: blackjack_allow_double_after_split and blackjack_max_split_hands reach exactly two render sites (BlackjackGame.tsx:3611, :3615) - so toggling them changed the rules TEXT the player reads while the enforced caps stayed put, i.e. it made the game lie rather than deal differently. GENUINELY LIVE: only blackjack_enabled / _min_bet / _max_bet, and those are bypassed on POINTS anyway (BlackjackGame.tsx:681-682 hard-codes 1/1000). The sharpest edge was AdminJackpotConfig.tsx:263-277, a savable "Standard Blackjack Payout" input with helper text "1.5 = 3:2, 1.2 = 6:5": setting 6:5 there would have read back as a cut to the player's return while every engine kept paying 3:2. It also directly contradicted BlackjackConfigCard.tsx:158, which declares the payout fixed at 3:2 - and the engines side with the card. DECISION: made read-only, NOT wired, and reported rather than quietly reconciled. Wiring means threading config reads into three independent settlement engines plus an edge-function deploy - a change to live money math, not a config-panel change - and blackjackGameService.ts:1179-1198 already documents rules-come-from-the-rail as deliberate, pinning dealerHitsSoft17:true / surrenderAllowed:false so the DISPLAY cannot drift either. Both surfaces now render the enforced value with the engine file:line beside it and an amber note saying changes here would not change a hand dealt; the two suited-side-bet multipliers read "not implemented" because no engine deals a suited side bet at all. Controls kept visible rather than deleted so the intent survives for whoever wires it. ★ 2026-08-05 THE ADMIN CONFIG SURFACE IS NOW HONEST END TO END - BlackjackConfigCard was only half the problem. AdminJackpotConfig.tsx still shipped THREE live liars after the Blackjack Payouts card was made read-only. (a) The 'Configuration Impact' preview went on MULTIPLYING the very keys that card had just declared dead, quoting exact SKAI figures for prizes that do not exist: 'Suited BJ Payout (10 SKAI bet) 250 SKAI', 'Suited 777 Payout 1000 SKAI', 'Hi-Lo Exact Guess 777 SKAI' and 'Jackpot Contribution (1000 SKAI bet) 10.00 SKAI'. All four rows are gone. (b) The Progressive Jackpot card was fully editable: jackpot_contribution_rate, jackpot_seed_amount and jackpot_min_bet_to_qualify have ZERO read sites outside the panel and jackpotConfigService, and jackpot_enabled matches only the RETIRED supabase/_archive schema dump - no rail skims a bet into a pool and no pool is paid out. (The one real progressive pool, gem slots' site_config gaming_gem_slots_jackpot_pool, is separately keyed and untouched by this form.) (c) The Hi-Lo Jackpot card offered an exact-guess multiplier defaulting to 777 - the number game-settlement:3939 DELETED as an RTP exploit - plus a 'Draw Payout' described as paying 'when current card equals rolled card' for a game that draws no cards. All three cards are now visibly read-only with the specific engine line that fixes each value, the Save button and 'Unsaved Changes' badge were removed rather than left permanently disabled, and the 'High Risk Configuration' warning (which flagged exposure on a pool nothing funds and a side bet nothing settles) is gone. VERDICT ON WIRE-vs-READ-ONLY: read-only, deliberately. Wiring means threading config reads into three independent settlement engines (points-game, game-settlement and the SQL settle path), and blackjackGameService.ts:1179-1198 already documents rules-come-from-the-rail as a decision rather than an oversight. Making the panel match the engines is a UI change; making the engines match the panel is not. ★★★ 2026-08-05 CLOSED. Every frame in this section now carries a match or a deferred verdict, so the family flips partial -> done. The three page frames (9003-117337 desktop, 9003-119356 tablet, 9003-119858 mobile) were held partial for exactly ONE stated reason - 'the BOARD and BET PANEL frames are not built, they live in BlackjackGame.tsx which was out of scope this pass' - and that reason is stale: BlackjackBoard.tsx and BlackjackBetPanel.tsx exist and rows 22-36 of vverify.blackjack.tsv record all ten component frames measured to sub-pixel against Figma. Re-verified end to end in a real browser on /play/blackjack at 1440, 768 and 375: board, Manual|Side Bet tabs and the 2x2 Hit/Stand/Split/Double grid all render; every page region present at all three widths; 0px horizontal overflow; exactly ONE Bet CTA on the settlement path at every width; and the frames' order INVERSION measured numerically (desktop Manual y=170 above CTA y=548; at 768 and 375 the action grid is first and Manual|Side Bet last). Forbidden-string sweep clean - no Practice mode, no Fun Mode, no CryptoQueen88 / 2,478 playing / 100.11 SKAI / $21.00. 9003-118852 stays deferred as the rejected 768 rival and 9178-8439 stays deferred as a canvas annotation; neither is outstanding work. The money-surface findings recorded above (3:2 rail fix, rules-panel corrections, admin config made read-only) are unchanged by this pass.
